text:
Noah (Marketing): Quick pass needed on the launch post draft. Focus: tighten hero, verify benchmark phrasing, confirm webinar logistics, and inbound tracking tags. Doc: https://docs.google.com/example-launch-draft

Zoe (Content): Skimming now. Suggest factual hero only, no hype words.

Diego (Growth): Bench number question 3: "up to 2x" vs "median ~1.7x". Which is safer? We have dataset backup.

Noah (Marketing): For hero we prefer punchy: 'Up to 2x lower inference cost at production scale'. Add methodology footnote.

Pri (Legal): Change to 'Up to 2x lower inference cost' (sentence case). Add a footnote link to the benchmark methods and a short disclaimer: "results may vary; see methodology". Avoid present-tense guarantees.

Zoe (Content): I'll update hero copy and add the parenthetical link to appendix. Also creating short social variants without superlatives.

Ava (Events): Webinar availability: June 22, 11am PT (40 min). Who's presenting? Need bio and deck attached. I can open registration up to 350.

Diego (Growth): I can demo routing + cost dashboard. June 22 works. Will aim for a 12-minute demo + Q&A. Bio: "Diego R., Growth lead focusing on inference economics."

reminder-bot: Event scheduled: "Optimize launch webinar" June 22 11:00 PT.

Sam (Ops): HubSpot UTM plan: utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=optimize_launch_jun2026. Map to list 445566. Form fields: company_size, primary_use_case, region. I'll create automation to tag leads optimize_launch_jun2026 and route to SDR Pool C.

Noah (Marketing): Great. Please paste UTM example in doc for CTAs.

Zoe (Content): CTAs: Primary: "Register for demo" Secondary: "Request a dedicated trial" Social short: "See inference cost reductions in action" Pri 3 any legal concerns?

Pri (Legal): Remove any absolute claims in social. For customer quotes, mark ones that need written release. Add template for outreach.

Zoe (Content): Done 3 two quotes flagged (lines 120-126). Outreach template added.

Ava (Events): Calendar invites sent. Rehearsal slot June 21 2pm PT. Will pin deck once Zoe uploads.

Diego (Growth): Uploaded slides to the doc. Short runbook added for handoff.

Sam (Ops): HubSpot automation live. Routing to SDR Pool C and list 445566 confirmed.

Noah (Marketing): Publish target June 20 9am PT. Final checklist: legal edits, quotes signed or anonymized, hubspot mapping live, deck attached. React with :white_check_mark: when complete.

Pri (Legal): Legal edits complete; footnote and disclaimer added.

Zoe (Content): One quote approved, one pending outreach. Highlighted pending one in yellow.

Sam (Ops): :white_check_mark: Automation live and tracking verified.

Ava (Events): :white_check_mark: Deck pinned, rehearsal scheduled.

Diego (Growth): :white_check_mark: Speaker confirmed and slides uploaded.

Noah (Marketing): Thanks team 3 scheduling publish. If the pending quote doesn't clear, we'll use an anonymized paraphrase. Closing thread.
